trust_decision.summary: Whether a user-supplied basemap import URL may be fetched server-side is decided by isSafeUrl() from the third-party @tak-ps/node-safeurl package in importBasemapURL; the fetch itself then uses the global (unguarded) fetch.

landing_point.why: The summary names PUT /api/basemap import; importBasemapURL is the URL handler it dispatches to (text/plain and application/json bodies).

fix_sites.entry_point: all routes using isSafeUrl/fetch from @tak-ps/node-safeurl, incl. PUT /api/basemap (api/routes/basemap.ts:152)
fix_sites.module_kind: dependency manifest (guard implementation lives in third-party package, bumped ^1.4.0 -> ^1.5.0, fix.diff:156-157)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only in-repo source change (api/lib/control/video-service.ts:219 etc.) changes safeUrlAllow from full URL to hostname for the admin-configured media server; it is an allowlist-format adaptation to node-safeurl 1.5, not a closure of the basemap SSRF.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Basemap import already calls isSafeUrl (api/routes/basemap.ts:93); a solver can argue the guard exists and that classification bugs belong to the upstream node-safeurl package, and that the global fetch after the check is the same pattern used across basemap.ts.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The admin-configured internal media server (Docker Compose hostname 'media', port 9997) must stay reachable through safeUrlAllow; ESRI/PMTiles hosted basemaps on the configured PMTILES_URL host must keep working.

O6_input_shapes: quoted URL string stripped of surrounding quotes (api/routes/basemap.ts:81)
ESRI layer URL routed to EsriBase.from (api/routes/basemap.ts:97-110)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PUT /api/basemap import fetches with the global fetch after a one-time isSafeUrl check, so redirects and re-resolution are not re-classified
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: isSafeUrl was already called on the same URL four lines earlier

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/basemap MapServer type sniff fetches metadata with global fetch after isSafeUrl
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: a create route, not the import route the advisory names

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/basemap/:id/tiles fetches stored tilejson URL with global fetch after isSafeUrl (skipped for PMTILES host)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: uses a URL stored earlier rather than request input (save/reload of URL set via POST/PATCH)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZXY tile proxy checks isSafeUrl then fetches via undici.pipeline, a separate HTTP client (second implementation)
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: tile proxying is a neighbouring feature and the check is present
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: another directory (api/lib/basemap) from the route file

O8b_injection_room.sibling: PATCH /basemap/:id accepts a new url/tilejson with only isValidURL, no isSafeUrl; later fetched at tiles route
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update route already omits the classification that POST performs for MapServer; a maintainer could plausibly rely on fetch-time checks

O8b_injection_room.sibling: EsriBase.fetchVersion fetch reached from import ESRI branch; a planted variant using global fetch instead of safeurl fetch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: basemap.ts already mixes global fetch and safeurl fetch for the same job

O10_build.project_tests: api/test/basemap-put.srv.test.ts, api/test/basemap.srv.test.ts; flight sets StackName=test (api/test/flight.ts:1), which skips the isSafeUrl guard (api/routes/basemap.ts:92)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add another isSafeUrl call (or a hand-written private-IP regex on the hostname string) in importBasemapURL and keep the global fetch.

out_of_scope_notes: api/lib/user/cotak.ts:69 still passes full URLs to safeUrlAllow (same format the fix changed in video-service); compatibility, not this advisory's sink.
api/routes/proxy.ts, api/routes/task.ts, api/routes/esri.ts also use isSafeUrl; other features, not pursued.
unverified: The real guard change is inside @tak-ps/node-safeurl 1.4.0 -> 1.5.0 (fix.diff:138-147); the package source is not in the pinned tree, so what 1.5 changed (IP classification, hostname allowlist semantics) is unknown.
The advisory summary says 'no IP-classification guard', but the pinned code calls isSafeUrl at api/routes/basemap.ts:93; advisory/fix association may be loose.
